name: Novel to Beat Sheet
description: Declarative compression of a novel passage into an ordered beat sheet. Adaptation execution is not implemented.

stages.title: Novel Passage
stages.intent: Select the source passage. Do not fetch or mutate novel files here.

stages.title: Narrative Intent
stages.intent: State what the passage must still mean after compression.

stages.title: Essential Events
stages.intent: Keep only events the later film still requires.

stages.title: Character Beats
stages.intent: Record recognitions, decisions, and relationship turns.

stages.title: Conflict Beats
stages.intent: Record opposition moves that remain visible on screen.

stages.title: Emotional Beats
stages.intent: Record feeling-turns that need a visual or spoken home.

stages.title: Beat Sheet
stages.intent: Assemble an ordered beat list. Execution of adaptation is not implemented.
